description: Example configuration for the nightly Copilot Dream consolidation for a fictional service 'acme-api'. Copy this to ~/.copilot/dream/config.json and edit identity/paths/thresholds. harvest.py, ledger.py, run-dream.ps1 and the consolidation prompt all read this file.

model_policy.note: Cost-conscious default: GPT-5.6 Sol. All agents and retries must explicitly use long_context and xhigh reasoning; no automatic, alternate-model, or default-context fallback.

window.note: First run looks back default_hours; later runs resume at the previous successful harvest cutoff minus overlap_minutes, capped at max_hours.

domain.off_domain_note: Off-domain personal projects and machine-maintenance chatter are DROPPED from the reference skills. Keep something only if it reveals a durable, reusable dev-workflow lesson.

agent_memory.note: Repo-specific coding patterns go to per-repo .github/agent-history/*.md via the repo-memory protocol, NOT to personal skills.

thresholds.note: SHORT items seen >= promote_hit_count over >= promote_distinct_days distinct days become promotion candidates (feature-scoped status never promotes). Active SHORT items untouched for decay_days are archived. Only HIGH-confidence LONG items auto-apply; others go to review-queue. Items with importance < importance_keep_floor are dropped unless part of an active thread. Skills over their char budget are edited without growing.
